context: This item never performs the decisions or the work they unblock; it only carries them so they cannot be lost between sessions. Agents keep reports/human-decision-queue.md current, add evidence as it lands, and record each ruling in place with a date. The item completes only when no entry is still marked PENDING.
description: Eight decisions block the memory remediation effort and none may be taken by an agent. D1 promotion ruling for the v3 Claude candidate, which strictly dominates its baseline but is held by a pair-scoped gate. D2 promotion ruling for the v5 Codex candidate, which beats baseline on correctness, recall, and payload but fails on decision-label flags. D3 evaluator taxonomy redesign versus per-scenario adjudication. D4 the two classifier-blocked v3 oracle adjudications. D5 authorization to spend new model quota. D6 live-mutation boundary sign-off for phase 4. D7 closure of the stale v2 phase-3 item whose work units were correctly never executed. D8 the terminal drop of a superseded v3 item. Full statements, evidence, and options are in reports/human-decision-queue.md.
